name: @pipeworx/mcp-ebid

tools.name: ebid_search
tools.description: Search listings on the eBid.net online marketplace and auction site (eBid Trading API SearchEbid). Filter by keyword, category, price range, item condition (NEW/USED/UNUSED/REFURBISHED), buy-now only, seller username, or country of origin, on any of eBid's 20+ country sites. Set closed=true to search ended listings instead of live ones — ended listings with bids are where realized sale prices live. Returns total match count and listings with ListingID, title, bid count, currency and buy-now price. eBid is a small marketplace; treat results as a secondary listings and price source.

keyword.description: Search keyword(s), same rules as the eBid site search box. Searched in titles by default.

site.description: eBid country site to query (2-letter code, e.g. "us", "uk", "de"). Defaults to "us". Prices come back in that site's currency.

category_id.description: Restrict to an eBid category (numeric CategoryID from ebid_categories).

min_price.description: Minimum price, in the site's currency.

max_price.description: Maximum price, in the site's currency.

buy_now_only.description: true = only listings with a buy-now option.

closed.description: true = search ONLY closed (ended) listings instead of live ones. Sort defaults to most recently closed.

username.description: Only listings from this eBid seller username.

country.description: Only items located in this country (2-letter code, e.g. "us").

search_descriptions.description: true = search item descriptions as well as titles.

sort.description: Sort order. CLOSED_* sorts apply only when closed=true.

rows.description: Rows per page, max 75 (eBid API cap). Default 25.

_apiKey.description: Optional — eBid API credentials as "AppId:AppKey" (both issued together, free, at the eBid developer portal ebid.3scale.net). The gateway supplies a platform key, so omit this and calls still work; pass your own only to override ours.

tools.name: ebid_listing
tools.description: Fetch one eBid.net listing by its numeric ListingID (eBid Trading API GetListingSingle): title, description, seller, current price, bid count, quantity, condition, start/end times, and shipping cost calculated to a destination country. Works for live and ended listings on any eBid country site. Get ListingIDs from ebid_search. Bids are served through a 5-minute result cache, so the current bid can be up to five minutes old: near the close of an auction treat it as a lower bound, never as the final price.

listing_id.description: Numeric eBid ListingID (from ebid_search results or an ebid.net listing URL).

site.description: eBid country site to query (2-letter code, e.g. "us", "uk", "de"). Defaults to "us". Prices come back in that site's currency.

ship_to.description: ISO country code to calculate shipping to (e.g. "us", "uk"). Defaults to the site's country.

_apiKey.description: Optional — eBid API credentials as "AppId:AppKey" (both issued together, free, at the eBid developer portal ebid.3scale.net). The gateway supplies a platform key, so omit this and calls still work; pass your own only to override ours.

tools.name: ebid_listing_bids
tools.description: Bid history for one eBid.net listing (eBid Trading API GetListingBids): each bid's amount, quantity, bidder username, timestamp, and whether it was a buy-now or proxy bid. On an ended auction the winning (highest) bid is the realized price. Get ListingIDs from ebid_search. Bid history is served through a 5-minute result cache, so the latest bids on a live auction can be up to five minutes behind.

site.description: eBid country site to query (2-letter code, e.g. "us", "uk", "de"). Defaults to "us". Prices come back in that site's currency.

_apiKey.description: Optional — eBid API credentials as "AppId:AppKey" (both issued together, free, at the eBid developer portal ebid.3scale.net). The gateway supplies a platform key, so omit this and calls still work; pass your own only to override ours.

tools.name: ebid_categories
tools.description: Browse the eBid.net marketplace category tree (eBid Trading API GetCategoryList): category IDs, names, full paths and per-category item counts for an eBid country site. Pass a parent category_id to list its subcategories, or omit it for the root categories. Use the returned CategoryID to filter ebid_search.

category_id.description: Parent CategoryID to list children of. Omit for root categories.

site.description: eBid country site to query (2-letter code, e.g. "us", "uk", "de"). Defaults to "us". Prices come back in that site's currency.

_apiKey.description: Optional — eBid API credentials as "AppId:AppKey" (both issued together, free, at the eBid developer portal ebid.3scale.net). The gateway supplies a platform key, so omit this and calls still work; pass your own only to override ours.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-ebid forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the ebid pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
